# Kanya Hunt — Couverture Cake Artist · Cape Town

> Kanya Hunt is a bespoke couverture chocolate cake artist based in Melkbosstrand, Cape Town, South Africa. She designs and hand-sculpts wedding cakes, celebration cakes, and weekend cakes — every decorative element made from premium Callebaut Belgian couverture chocolate, entirely by hand. She serves Cape Town and the Winelands.

## About

Kanya Hunt has worked exclusively with fine couverture chocolate for 25 years. With a background as a qualified dietician (Galliova 2003), she brings an analytical understanding of flavour, chemistry, and texture to her work. Every cake is an original commission — she does not copy other artists' work.

## What She Creates

- Couverture chocolate wedding cakes — dark and dramatic, hand-sculpted ruffles, petals, and spirals
- White couverture wedding cakes — pearl-on-pearl, blush ruffles, ivory florals
- Buttercream and sugar art wedding cakes — on request
- Celebration cakes — birthdays, anniversaries, milestones
- Petite creations — individual mini cakes and cupcakes
- Weekend Cakes — a weekly rotating menu of 3–4 cakes, announced Monday, delivered Friday, no customisation

## Pricing (as at 2026)

- Single tier: from R2,750
- Two tiers: from R3,500
- Three tiers: from R5,250
- Four tiers: from R6,500
- Weekend Cakes: R975–R1,065 (16 portions)
